cards.headline: Left off Pop 2, kept alive by a Tokyo stage
cards.snippet: Charli XCX began recording 'party 4 u' with A. G. Cook in May 2017 for her mixtape Pop 2, then left it off the tracklist. A performance at a Tokyo concert that month made it a fan favourite, and for three years it lived on as snippets surfacing in her live shows and online videos. She finally finished it in lockdown for How I'm Feeling Now (2020), slowing the uptempo EDM-trap drafts into what she called 'euphoric and sad at the same time'.
cards.context: Wikipedia song article — background and composition sections.

cards.headline: The outro is a real Brixton crowd, going home
cards.snippet: Near the end, the song opens out into the sound of a crowd going home — because that crowd is real: the Brixton Academy audience from her 2019 London show, recorded as that concert ended and folded into a track she finished a year later in lockdown. The song was meant to close How I'm Feeling Now, but she cut the idea, deciding it felt 'too traditional' — the crowd noise made it sound 'like an emotional goodbye'.

cards.headline: Normalize the five-year-late music video
cards.snippet: We should normalize artists releasing MV for old songs, bc this is a MASTERPIECE
cards.context: Said of the official video, which arrived May 15, 2025 — five years after the album it belongs to.

cards.headline: Destroying yourself for someone who won't look up
cards.snippet: the embarrassment of realizing how you’ve destroyed yourself over someone who will never spare you a fraction of a second is so deep and real, thank you for this charli.
cards.context: The embarrassment reading of the song, stated in full — the pool's deepest comment, on the official video.

replies.author: @robertoXCX
replies.text: It's the duality of Charli, equal parts 365 party girl and devastating heartbreaks and earthquakes girl.

cards.headline: The platform itself kept it brief
cards.context: Posted by YouTube's own account under the official video; the wait it names ran from the 2020 album to the May 2025 video.

replies.author: @jakeisagirl
replies.text: Don’t act like you were there…

replies.author: @alaissance
replies.text: oh shut up it's not like YOU actually waited 5 years 😭

cards.headline: Everything for someone who barely notices
cards.snippet: The song for when you do everything for someone and they barely even notice you… charli we love you.
cards.context: The song's whole plot in one line: maximum effort, minimum acknowledgment.

cards.headline: The Chainsmokers Remix: five minutes in 2:15
cards.snippet: The Chainsmokers' remix, released June 18, 2025, cuts the five-minute album track down to 2:15 and re-aims it at the club — the upload tags it techno and EDM. One listener: "finally a new tcs remix, this time they tried this kind of piano-speed up house/bouncy techno style,"
cards.context: Uploaded to The Chainsmokers' official channel.

version.versionLabel: Charli XCX - party 4 u (The Chainsmokers Remix)

cards.headline: Bottoms (2023) saves it for the final scene
cards.snippet: 'Party 4 U' was featured in the final scene of Bottoms (2023), Emma Seligman's high-school comedy — two years before the song's viral second life, and the official audio's top comments are still full of listeners it sent there.
cards.context: The placement predates the virality: the 2020 official audio's thread is full of Bottoms arrivals, from 'bottoms send me here' to viewers calling it Josie and Isabel's theme.
